entities.name: Salima Abi Rashed
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Salima Abi Rashed, was a Lebanese lawyer and journalist, considered the country's first female lawyer. She founded one of Lebanon's earliest women's magazines, Fatat Lobnan, in 1914.
